description: This file provides a PHP class implementation for database driver and recordset handling specifically for Oracle OCI8 within the ADODB database abstraction layer. It includes methods for connection management, query execution, transaction control, metadata retrieval, BLOB handling, and query limiting tailored for Oracle databases.

classes.name: ADODB_oci8
classes.description: Main class implementing Oracle OCI8 driver for ADODB, handling connection, querying, transaction control, metadata, and BLOB operations.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oci8
classes.description: Recordset class for handling query results from OCI8, supporting data fetching, field info, and navigation.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ext_oci8
classes.description: Extended recordset class with custom move-next implementation for OCI8.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata columns for a specified table, with normalization and schema support.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Returns current timestamp from the Oracle database.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Handles different connection modes to the Oracle database.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves database server info including version and compatibility.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Persistent connection method.

methods.name: _nconnect
methods.description: Non-persistent connection method.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by last query.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns SQL expression with NVL for handling null values.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Fetches the last insert ID from a sequence for a given table and column.

methods.name: DBDate
methods.description: Converts a PHP date to Oracle TO_DATE format string.

methods.name: BindDate
methods.description: Prepares date string for binding in SQL.

methods.name: BindTimeStamp
methods.description: Prepares timestamp for binding.

methods.name: DBTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts timestamp to Oracle TO_DATE format string.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Performs row locking with FOR UPDATE.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of table metadata, supports schema masking.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index metadata for a given table.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back current transaction.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects database; not implemented for Oracle.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves last error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Retrieves last error code.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Formats a date column in SQL using TO_CHAR.

methods.name: GetRandRow
methods.description: Fetches a random row from a query.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Implements query limiting with response to offset and row count, using Oracle-specific syntax.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Stores a BLOB or CLOB in the database.

methods.name: UpdateBlobFile
methods.description: Stores a file as a BLOB or CLOB.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes SQL with optional input parameters, handles statement preparation and execution.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an Oracle statement for execution.

methods.name: releaseStatement
methods.description: Frees OCI statement resources.

methods.name: ExecuteCursor
methods.description: Executes a procedure returning a cursor as a recordset.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds PHP variable to OCI statement, with support for LOBs.

methods.name: Param
methods.description: Generates bind parameter name.

methods.name: Parameter
methods.description: Binds variable to statement with option for input/output.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes database connection and frees resources.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Fetches primary key constraints.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a table.
